newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: Iranians may help train Mozambican army.
newsitem.headline: Iranians may help train Mozambican army.

text.p: Iranian Defence Minister Mohammad Forouzandeh visited Mozambique's biggest barracks on Tuesday after talks on possible military training for the Mozambican army.
Boane barracks, southwest of the capital Maputo, has been one of the main military training centres in Mozambique since Portuguese colonial times.
Mozambican Defence Minister Aguiar Mazula said after talks on Monday that training was on the agenda although his country has no current military links with Iran.
Forouzandeh arrived on Sunday and will leave on Wednesday.
